message.reasoning_content:
We need to classify relation between two statements. Both are from same actor (same person) in two public hearings. Manifestation A is about "Revisão do Marco Legal da Inovação para facilitar sua operacionalização". He discusses issues with the legal framework, complains about restrictions, wants operationalization, etc. He seems to be critical of current law, but also satisfied? He says "Estou satisfeito" but also "vou fazer críticas". He wants mechanisms institutionalized, not just change law. He seems to be in favor of revising/operationalizing the Marco Legal da Inovação, i.e., supportive of changes to improve.

Manifestation B is about "Discussão sobre mudanças na Lei do Bem para facilitar a colaboração entre universidades, empresas e governo e promover inovações". He talks about need to improve application of Lei do Bem, wants better collaboration, mentions law 13.243 (Marco Legal de Ciência e Tecnologia) and its provisions, says they are good but not applied, wants to lubricate mechanisms, etc. He is supportive of changes to facilitate collaboration, wants better implementation.

Both are about legal frameworks for science/innovation. Are they responding to same specific proposition? Not exactly same proposition: A is about revising the Marco Legal da Inovação (the legal framework for innovation) to operationalize it. B is about changes to Lei do Bem (tax incentive law) and also about implementation of Marco Legal de Ciência e Tecnologia. The specific proposition: "Revisar o Marco Legal da Inovação" vs "Modificar a Lei do Bem". They are different propositions. So they are not same specific proposition. Both have stance: they are in favor of changes/improvements. So stance same direction (favor). But since not same proposition, classification should be INCOMPARABLE (they have determinable positions but not same proposition). According to categories: INCOMPARABLE.

Thus output JSON with relation INCOMPARABLE and brief reasoning.
